'''Silvia Felipo Suñe'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Felipo|Suñe}} (born 4 February 1967) is an Andorran [[middle-distance running|middle-distance runner]]. She competed in the [[1500 metres]] at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]] and the [[2004 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/fe/silvia-felipo-1.html |title=Silvia Felipo |access-date=4 November 2017 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203043620/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/fe/silvia-felipo-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Silvia Felipo Suñe}}</ref>
